"Shower" is a song by American singer and rapper Becky G.
It was released on April 23, 2014, by Kemosabe Records and RCA Records.
Luke, Cirkut, and Rock City and it was produced by the former two.
American singer Becky G has released four studio albums, one extended play (EP), 91 singles (including 26 as a featured artist) and 18 promotional singles.
According to the Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA), she has achieved 17 million certified units.
She has a total of 8 chart entries on the US Billboard Hot 100, and 30 chart entries on the Hot Latin Songs, including a number-one and six top ten songs.
Rebbeca Marie Gomez (born March 2, 1997), known professionally as Becky G, is an American singer and actress.
